project.title: HeyPCB ESP32-S3 Sensors 2: Motion, Magnetic, Sound & Power
project.summary: ESP32-S3 boards, one sensor each: IMUs, accelerometers, magnetometers, Hall and angle sensors, microphones, distance, touch, optical and current monitors. KiCad 10, JLCPCB-ready, CERN-OHL-S-2.0.

boards.title: HeyPCB S3 ADXL343
